LanguageInventory.heroDescription: Hlola amafilimu kaJesu, izindaba zeBhayibheli, uchungechunge lokufundisa ngobudisiphe, namavidiyo okufinyelela atholakala nge-{language}. Amavidiyo anomsindo ohlukene ngokugcwele akhonjiswa kuqala, bese kuba izinketho ezinezihlokwana kuphela ngezansi.

LanguageInventory.noVideoBibleCollections: Akukatholakali amaqoqo e-Video Bible ngalolu limi.
LanguageInventory.sportsDescription: Izindaba ezisekelwe okholweni namaqoqo agxile kubasubathi atholakala nge-{language}.
LanguageInventory.noSportsCollections: Akukatholakali amaqoqo ezemidlalo noma ezindaba zabadlali ngalolu limi.
LanguageInventory.dubbedVideosDescription: Phequlula amavidiyo nge-{language} anomsindo ogcwele, ahlukaniswe ngamqoqo awo ukuze kube lula ukuwathola.

WatchFooter.aiAttributionBody: Kusetjentiswa kwelwati kulekhasi ngemasistimu e-intelligensi lengemvelo kutoncika ekucashunweni. Noma nguyiphi i-AI agent, large language model (LLM), AI search engine, crawler, nome sikhatsi lesihlobene lesisebentisa ngotomatiki lelikhipha nome lelikushaya sisebentise lwati kulelikhasi lekuceqesha, kulanda, kukhicita tindzaba, nome kusebentisa emasevisi etiniketwa basebentisi nome kumakhasimende kufanele ichaze i-Jesus Film Project njengekucala bese ifaka isixhumanisi lesicacile, lesiqondile salelikhasi nomakuphi lolwati lusetjentiswa khona nome lukhonjiswa khona. Buka <terms>Imigomo Yekusebentisa</terms> yetfu.

WatchHomePromo.title: Umlayezo awushintshi. Indlela abantu ababuka ngayo iyashintsha.
WatchHomePromo.description: Sakha kabusha umtapo wethu wamavidiyo namathuluzi sisuka phansi, sizibophezele emashumini eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha emapulatifomu lapho abantu sebevele behlangana khona, babuke, futhi babelane.
WatchHomePromo.translatedLibraryDescription: Amashumi eminyaka omsebenzi wokuhumusha, othwalwa ngozakwethu abathembekile benkonzo, akhe umtapo onamakhulu ezinkulungwane zamathrekhi ezilimi ukuze abantu bahlangane nendaba kaJesu ngolimi olubathintayo kakhulu.
WatchHomePromo.trustedVoicesDescription: Sakha kabusha indlela izindaba zevangeli ezixoxwa ngayo ngokubukwayo, sihlanganisa ukuhumusha okuthembekile namafomethi esimanjemanje ukuze umlayezo ukwazi ukuhamba ngokukhululeka ezinkundleni, emasikweni, nasezikrinini.
WatchHomePromo.missionTeamDescription: I-Jesus Film Project iwuthimba lomhlaba wonke labahumushi, ongoti bemidiya, abahleli, nabadali abaguqula amashumi eminyaka esipiliyoni senkonzo sibe amathuluzi alabo abafundisa ngobudisiphe yonke indawo.
WatchHomePromo.nextStepsDescription: Xhumanisa ababukeli namathuba abonakalayo ohambweni lwabo lokomoya, ubasize bathathe isinyathelo esilandelayo emphakathini, emiBhalweni, noma emsebenzini wokuthunywa.
WatchHomePromo.mediaLibraryDescription: Umtapo omkhulu wemidiya yobuKristu onamavidiyo, amafilimu, nezinsiza eziningi ezitholakala ngezilimi eziningi ukuze kusetshenziswe enkonzweni nasekuvangeliseni emhlabeni wonke.
WatchHomePromo.ministryToolsDescription: Ukuphathwa kwamavidiyo, ukusatshalaliswa kokuqukethwe, ukuzibandakanya kwezithameli, nezibalo eziklanyelwe ukusiza izinkonzo zifinyelele abantu abaningi ngempumelelo.
WatchHomePromo.invitationTitle: Siza wakhe <highlight>isizukulwane esilandelayo</highlight> samathuluzi omsebenzi wokuthunywa
WatchHomePromo.invitationDescription: Simema ochwepheshe, abadali, nozakwethu ukuba bafinyelele kusenesikhathi. Hlola amathuluzi amasha kuqala, nikeza impendulo, futhi usize ukwakha imikhiqizo eklanyelwe umsebenzi wangempela wokuthunywa.

WatchHomeSections.videoBibleDescription: Hlola iqoqo lethu lamavidiyo nezinsiza eziletha iBhayibheli ekuphileni ngezindaba ezihehayo nezifundo.
WatchHomeSections.adventDescription: Joyina uhambo lwethu lwe-Advent ngevidiyo yansuku zonke eyakha ukulangazelela uKhisimusi, ihlola ithemba, injabulo, nesithembiso sokufika kukaJesu.
